title: [Frontend][Experiment] Add opt-out danmaku feedback wall for newcomer friction
body:
## Goal Add a lightweight, opt-out "friction wall" (danmaku) to the MisakaNet frontend. Users can post short messages about where they got stuck. This becomes a **real-time friction sensor** for the maintainer. Not a comment section. Not a chat room. A friction sensor. ## User Experience ### Toggle button Add a visible button near the top area: ``` 💬 Danmaku ON (click to toggle) 💬 Danmaku OFF ``` - Desktop: default ON - Mobile: default OFF (screen too small) - Preference saved in `localStorage` ### Input Floating input at bottom-right: ``` Say where you got stuck... [ type here ] [Send] ``` Prompt: "You can vent, ask questions, or just send an emoji. Please do not post secrets, tokens, or personal info." ### Display - Slow scroll speed - Desktop: max 8-12 visible - Mobile: max 3-5 visible - Does not block core interactions - One-click close always visible ## Filtering Rules Filter only: attacks, slurs, tokens/secrets, personal info, spam, URL spam. **Do NOT filter negative feedback.** These are valuable: - "README 看不懂" - "不知道 node 是什么" - "我不会 GitHub" - "这个页面好乱" - "this lesson was useless for me because..." ## Data Model ```json { "id": "dm_20260719_xxx", "text": "我不知道 node 是什么", "lang": "zh", "status": "visible", "source": "web", "created_at": "2026-07-19T..." } ``` ## Technical (MVP) ``` frontend -> POST /api/danmaku -> Cloudflare Worker -> filter -> KV/D1 -> frontend polls last 50 ``` Admin (minimal): `POST /api/danmaku/hide`, `scripts/export_danmaku.py`, `scripts/moderate_danmaku.py` ## Value Loop ``` user vent -> friction signal -> journey report / rescue card / lesson candidate -> MisakaNet improves ``` ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Visible toggle near top area - [ ] On/off with localStorage persistence - [ ] Messages display without blocking core interactions - [ ] Mobile: does not cover buttons or search - [ ] No private data shown publicly - [ ] Filter blocks attacks/secrets/personal info/spam - [ ] Negative feedback NOT filtered - [ ] Input has public visibility disclaimer ## Boundary Notice > This is a public friction wall. Please do not post secrets or personal information. ## Please Do Not - Build a comment/reply system - Add user accounts for danmaku - Add emoji reactions or voting - Build an admin dashboard (first version) - Over-filter negative feedback ## Notes This is an experiment. If it produces useful friction signals, we iterate. If it produces noise, we remove it.
